messages:
Avery: Opening a short follow-up thread from today's all-hands. Drop quick Qs on mission, positioning, competitors, or roadmap clarifications. I'll tag folks.

Jordan: Quick: should SEs lead with 'developer-first' or 'inference economics' on discovery calls?

Sam: Developer-first for eng/product folks. Flip to inference economics (cost predictability, committed tiers) for procurement/finance. Tailor the opener.

Lee: Competitor angle: cloud vendors undercutting on GPU price  what do we say in 20s?

Riya: 20s reply: "Lower instance price ignores tail latency, rollout risk, and hidden token/unit costs. We provide SLA-backed latency, per-route cost visibility, and private-deploy controls (KMS/HSM)."

Marta: Roadmap: when do we expect per-route cost dashboards and tracing? Sales needs timelines.

Riya: Tracing internal alpha by end-of-Q2, public beta Q3. Per-route token & cost dashboards targeted Q3.

Jordan: Dedicated packaging: any immediate changes (burst credits, tiers)?

Avery: Launching burst-credit addon and clearer committed tiers next month. No price overhaul. Finance will publish an FAQ and sample quotes.

Sam: Demo tip until tracing: show per-request logs + synthetic replay to trigger fallback. Sample minimal config to demo fallback:

```json
{"route":"demo-chat","fallback":["rwd-small","rwd-micro"],"latency_slo_ms":160}
```

Lee: Collateral ask: can SEs get a one-pager comparing us vs managed cloud endpoints?

Sam: Yes  SEs/partners will get a one-pager + slide snippet by EOD Friday. Ping me for the internal perf pack if you need immediate numbers.

deploy-bot: all-hands-deck uploaded to #docs at 1857770035 :white_check_mark:

Avery: Thanks everyone  keep Qs short here or DM if sensitive. We'll leave this open for 24h. :sparkles:
